baslik: Manşet koşullama protokolüne bağlı: tutarlı her-ikisi-doğru protokolünde ViT yönlü olarak da zayıf bir kaynak çıkıyor
hakem_cumlesi: Under the both-correct protocol the source gap nearly doubles and its directional part rises from 0.02 to about 0.31, so the symmetric share falls to 0.58, the ViT's directional term becomes +0.19 and H3 is no longer equivalent; the ViT is then a directionally weak source as well, and the headline is a property of the target-correct protocol.

On kayit tanimi (src/analysis/protokoller.py:60 both_correct = tc & sc, kosegende w hedef-dogru) yari tutarli surume denk: ayrisim.json e_her_ikisi_dogru.cifar10 rho +0.492, H3 +0.244. Marjinal alt kume 1517/(1517+7061) ~ %18 (foy M8.5:1211-1215). Metinde mevcut: 04_experiments.tex:540 (3.91 puan), :154 ve 05_discussion.tex:69 (CIFAR-100 duyarliligi uretilmedi).
kapatan_is: Tutarli ve on kayit tanimli her-ikisi-dogru ayrisimlarini duyarlilik satiri olarak govdeye almak, CIFAR-100 icin S9-4'u uretmek, w'nin cifte bagli hale gelmesini yorumlamak ve hedef-dogru protokolun kestirilen nicelik olarak kuramsal savunmasini yazmak; savunulamazsa baslik ve manseti 'hedef-dogru protokolde' kaydiyla daraltmak.
dusecek_cumle: main.tex:133 "On CIFAR-10, 0.936 [0.925, 0.948] of ViT-Tiny's panel source gap to ResNet-18 is symmetric, and the ViT's directional term ($+0.012$) is equivalent to zero within $\pm0.10$."; 01_introduction.tex:28; main.tex:72 baslik "Less a Weak Source"

baslik: K-b'nin eşdeğerliği dar bir ölçek penceresinde; Önerme 2'nin h ölçeğiyle birincil ölçek arasında gerilim
hakem_cumlesi: The equivalence of the ViT's directional term holds only for kappa between -0.20 and 0.25 in a log-to-logit family, while H3 holds over a wide range; on the h scale that the authors single out as protocol-invariant, the directional term is -0.32 and H1 falls to -0.13, so the authors should explain why the protocol-invariant scale is not the primary one.

dusecek_cumle: 04_experiments.tex:506 "The log scale is primary because the quasi-symmetry form $T_{ij} = w_j\simt_{ij}$ is additive on it and because the registration fixed it as primary before any of these runs." (h olcegini neden birincil yapmadigini aciklamadikca eksik)

baslik: Sıfırdan satırındaki benzemezlik temiz doğrulukla ayrıştırılamıyor; doğruluğun payı %44 ile %88 arasında
hakem_cumlesi: The scratch-trained ViT is 12 points less accurate than every other cell; depending on the reference line, 44 to 88 percent of H1 moves with clean accuracy, and all of these estimates extrapolate far outside the accuracy range of the CNNs, so an accuracy-matched control is required before H1 can be read as an architecture effect.

dusecek_cumle: 01_introduction.tex:32 "Trained from scratch on the same input pipeline, the ViT is less similar to the panel than the ResNet ($\Asig{scr} = -0.364$)"; main.tex:72 "a Different One"; 05_discussion.tex:19 "The dissimilarity is present when both architectures are trained from scratch on a matched pipeline"

baslik: Mimari ailesi sorusunda kanıt karışık; ayrıştırıcı karşılaştırma için tek bir başka transformer var
hakem_cumlesi: The scratch ViT is closer to the ImageNet-initialized ViT than to the ResNets, which supports a family reading, but the ImageNet-initialized ViT is no closer to the scratch ViT than to the ResNets and the only other attention model in the matrix sits inside the CNN distribution, so without a second independently designed transformer trained under the same recipe, family dissimilarity cannot be separated from a solution specific to this ViT-Tiny.

kapatan_is: Ayni CIFAR tarifinde sifirdan iki bagimsiz transformer (DeiT-S ya da Swin-T) ve ConvNeXt-T, ikiser tohum (6 kosu); FLOP orani 2.53-2.55 (_ek_flop_olcumu.json) x R224-scr 4.09 sa = ~10 sa/kosu, 60 sa + matris 1 sa.
dusecek_cumle: 04_experiments.tex:147 "A general weakness of the ViT as a source would have lowered this within-family similarity as well." (yalniz genel kaynak zayifligina karsi kalir); main.tex:72 "a Different One" mimari ailesine baglanamaz

hakem_cumlesi: ViT-Tiny has half the parameters of ResNet-18 and the lowest clean accuracy in the design, so the architecture contrast is also a capacity contrast; the capacity-matched design the authors list as future work (ViT-S against ResNet-50) is needed before the result can be attributed to the architecture family.

Metinde ve onceki konseyde mevcut: 01_introduction.tex:42, 05_discussion.tex:23 ve :83, 03_hakem_R3_uygulanabilirlik.md:109.
kapatan_is: ViT-S ile ResNet-50 2x2, dort hucre, ucer tohum: ~7.1 sa/kosu (FLOP orani ~2.4 x 2.97 sa, foy M9.1:1470) x 12 = 85.5 sa + iki matris 2 sa.
dusecek_cumle: main.tex:72 baslik; 06_conclusion.tex:12 "Trained from scratch on a matched input pipeline and recipe, the ViT is less similar to the panel than the ResNet" mimari ailesi genellemesi olarak

baslik: Genelleme: tek 2x2 veri kümesi, CIFAR-100'de K-b çürümesi, ImageNet sıfırdan satırı belirsiz, tek AT tarifi
hakem_cumlesi: The two-by-two design exists only on CIFAR-10 with two small models and one fine-tuning recipe, the directional equivalence fails on CIFAR-100 and the only scratch pair at ImageNet scale is inconclusive, so the claim should either be replicated on a second dataset and a modern recipe or be restricted to this setting in the title.

dusecek_cumle: 06_conclusion.tex:12 "Measured against a fixed panel of robust CNNs, with the vulnerability of each target taken out, most of ViT-Tiny's source gap on CIFAR-10 is symmetric" (yalniz hedef-dogru kaydiyla); main.tex:72 baslik genelligi

baslik: Tek saldırı gücü ve tek epsilon; saldırı tarafı zayıf bir alternatif kümeyle sınanmış
hakem_cumlesi: All transfer matrices use a single ten-step attack at a single budget, and the only ViT-specific attack performs worse than PGD, so the retained fraction of 0.96 is measured against a weak alternative set; report the decomposition at epsilon of 4/255 and 16/255 and under input-diversity and more-step attacks.

kapatan_is: 20 modelli matrisi eps 4/255 ve 16/255'te yeniden uretmek (~0.5 sa/tur, foy M13.3 B9 833 s'den), PGD-50 ve DI/TI kaynak saldirilari (~2.5 sa), TGR dogrulamasi (0.5 sa).
dusecek_cumle: 01_introduction.tex:32 "a fraction of $0.960$ of the gap is retained"; 05_discussion.tex:21 "the gap between ResNet and ViT sources is retained under each source's best attack"

baslik: Başlatma demeti iki mimaride aynı değil
hakem_cumlesi: The ImageNet bundle is not the same for both architectures: the ViT starts from a DeiT checkpoint and the ResNet from an RSB-A1 checkpoint, with unrecorded top-1 accuracy, so the interaction H2 cannot be attributed to architecture by initialization rather than to the quality of two different pre-training recipes.

dusecek_cumle: 03_methodology.tex:96 "The bundle is the same for both architectures"; 01_introduction.tex:32 "ImageNet initialization raises the ViT's panel similarity more than the ResNet's (interaction $\Isig = +0.260$)"

baslik: V-scr hücresi başka kampanyadan; kalan fark donanım ve kod tarihi
hakem_cumlesi: The scratch ViT cell alone was trained on a different GPU with an older code version and was seen before registration; even if recipes and schedules match, a re-run in the same chain would remove the only cell-aligned campaign difference.

hakem_cumlesi: Two runs per new cell give one-degree-of-freedom variance estimates; the decisions survive Welch intervals, but with a Welch-Holm p of 0.042 for H2 the margin is thin, and five seeds per cell would make the two-by-two inference credible.

baslik: w beyaz kutu saldırısına bağlı; AutoAttack'lı w ile farklı bir bölüştürme q'yu 0,866'ya taşır
hakem_cumlesi: Vulnerability is measured with PGD-10, whose gap to AutoAttack differs by architecture; replacing w alone with its AutoAttack value moves the symmetric share to 0.87 and H3 to +0.045, which shows that the split between vulnerability and direction depends on the white-box attack and calls for the full decomposition under a stronger attack.

hakem_cumlesi: The +-0.10 margin is defined in log units from a pool that contains the ViT itself and has no counterpart on the logit, h or both-correct scales, where the same quantity moves by 0.2 to 0.5, so equivalence should also be stated against a margin expressed relative to the source gap.

hakem_cumlesi: Checkpoints are selected by validation PGD accuracy at epochs 16 to 57, and in the original pair the last checkpoint lowers the pairwise similarity by 0.09, a quarter of H1; the two-by-two contrasts should be shown at the last checkpoint and along the training trajectory.
